calls.remote_control_hint: Allow API-key-authenticated phones to place and manage calls. Call settings stay on this computer.
calls.hint: Calls run through your paired computer and its configured Twilio number. Enable paired call control on that computer first.
calls.authentication: Pair using the computer’s API key to control calls. A sharing PIN cannot authorize calls.
calls.clone_hint: Whisper transcribes your sample. A separate cloning model generates a cloned preview before saving; both models are required.

host.title: Phone speech API
host.hint: Serve the selected installed voice through an OpenAI-style speech endpoint and MCP (2025-11-25). Runs only while this screen is open and the app is active.
host.lan_hint: Off: this phone only. On: devices on your network can connect using the temporary bearer token. Keep the token private.
